idea-plugin.name: Lattency
idea-plugin.description:
See where your code leaves the process.

Lattency marks every Java method that performs I/O - database, HTTP, messaging or file system - directly or through the methods it calls, so you can tell at a glance whether a change adds or moves I/O without walking the call chain by hand.

  • A gutter icon per I/O category, dimmed when the method only reaches I/O transitively.
  • A marker on every line that calls into I/O-colored code.
  • A tooltip naming the whole chain, e.g. place → OrderRepository.save → [DB], and click-through navigation to any method along it.
  • Works with no configuration on a typical Spring Boot project: Spring Data repositories, RestClient, RestTemplate, WebClient, HttpClient, OkHttp, Feign, JDBC, Kafka, Pub/Sub, JMS, RabbitMQ, and java.io / java.nio.file.
  • Understands @Blocking, @NonBlocking and @Cacheable.
  • Extend it with a lattency.yml committed at your project root: custom sinks, exclusions, and the propagation depth.

The analysis is entirely static - no agent, no running application, no telemetry. Markers can be turned off in Settings | Editor | General | Gutter Icons.

Java only for now. Kotlin support is not implemented.
